title: Short-period frequency floor (Figure 1, Category A): Level 1, Category A

ruleset.name: MIL-F-8785C
ruleset.basis: Class IV; bare airframe; the classical modes of the linear model are the equivalent system (3.1.12)

source.extract_quote: L1: ω ≥ **1.0** (hatched line on the 1.0 grid line)

scale_basis: the magnitude of the lower bound

conditions.search: grid, optional one-step local refinement around the critical point

status_policy.rule: No status other than OK can improve a verdict (FC-702); a DIVERGENT point fails every Level; no usable point gives NOT_ASSESSABLE (FC-701)

notes: Horizontal hatched floors on Figure 1: Level 1 at omega_nsp = 1.0 (on the 1.0 grid line), Level 2 at 0.6 (on the 0.6 grid line; value read graphically, not printed). Level 3 has no floor on Figure 1 (only the CAP 0.16 line). Combine with CAP: lower bound = max(floor, sqrt(CAP_min * n/alpha)).
